quantitative_overrides.fin_note: FY2025 peak Owner EPS normalized to 43.04p underlying earnings (stripping non-cash deferred tax asset releases and mark-to-market currency hedge credits). Operating ROIC capped at 35.0% tangible capital ceiling reflecting negative working capital customer advance structure. 5-10Y forward growth of 10.5% driven by widebody engine flying-hour expansion (4.5%), TotalCare LTSA contract resets & spare parts pricing (2.5%), defense and power systems demand (2.0%), and net buybacks (1.0%). Pristine net cash sheet (£4.3B net cash).
